g.text: Cyberdeck is becoming a modular terminal workspace. Today the deck gained:
- a system manifest for safe diagnostics
Prepare the public release, trusted publishing, and Homebrew tap.
Keep the deck small, composable, and operator-owned.
^L COMMAND ESC RETURN TO EDITOR ^S SAVE UTF-8 // 日本語対応
^N NEW ^R RESTORE ^G CONTROL ^P SWITCH ^B DISPATCH ^M MODULE ^L CMD ^S SAVE ^O OPS ^Q QUIT
